title: Growth, Pivoting, and Backward Error in the Purcell–Egerváry–Castillo Matrix Inverse
description: Frozen software and reproducibility materials for the numerical experiments accompanying the manuscript 'Growth, Pivoting, and Backward Error in the Purcell–Egerváry–Castillo Matrix Inverse'. Version 1.1.0 adds an explicit LAPACK xGETRF+xGETRI production baseline, deterministic balanced-sample reconstruction, a strict six-method paired residual comparison, and metric-validity accounting, while preserving the original campaign, diagonal-dominance, defect-replay, and high-precision validation material. The linked Zenodo dataset record preserves the original public reproducibility dataset.
